documents.title: Customer incident description (written statement)
documents.text:
Statement regarding my car claim - Arjun Mehta, policy NMS-PC-208915

On the evening of 14th February 2026 we were coming back from my cousin's engagement function in Rohini. I was tired after the long day so my brother Karan Mehta was driving and I was in the passenger seat. Near the Mangolpuri flyover on the Outer Ring Road a bike suddenly cut across from the left. Karan turned the wheel sharply to avoid hitting him and the left side of the car scraped hard against the divider and we hit the kerb.

The car was drivable but the left side is badly scratched and the front left portion is damaged. Next day we sent the car to Capital Motors garage at Peeragarhi as it started making a noise from the front.

No person was injured in this and there was no police case. The bike rider drove away. I request you to please process the claim at the earliest as I need the car for office.

Arjun Mehta
20/02/2026
